ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. The daily cycle has already failed (broke its own start low). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 5.1. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.

ladder.why_zh: 短期来看，正在形成日线筑底形态——但大局看空（weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)）。此处的反弹属于逆势：与周线周期低点不对齐的日线周期低点往往呈左移结构并最终失败，随后向更大周期低点蔓延——这正是在下行的投资者周期中买入日线低点的陷阱。日线周期已经失败（跌破其自身的起始低点）。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。

ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。
